title: Senior System Software Engineer - Graphics
description:
NVIDIA invites world-class and innovative software engineers to join the DirectX Graphics software team. You will focus on DirectX Driver software development for a wide GPU lineup. Our efforts have a significant impact on gaming, graphics, accelerated computing, and AI, reaching academic institutions, startups, and industry leaders globally. We are searching for passionate, hardworking, and creative engineers who can help us reach our engineering goals while also discovering ways to improve and automate engineering workflows through AI agents.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**
You will develop and maintain outstanding DirectX Graphics Drivers for NVIDIA GPUs, with a focus on supporting single-GPU system architectures. The work involves:
  
  

* Development of new OS and new chip graphics features for upcoming operating systems and GPU architectures
* Developing and driving quality improvement initiatives to deliver the best possible gaming experience on NVIDIA GPUs
* Advancement of graphics and AI-based post-processing features and graphics algorithms for high-end rendering
* Development of fundamental software stacks and features to use AI in graphics
* Exploring methods to automate engineering workflows using AI agents, involving activities such as debugging, testing, triage, code analysis, documentation, and boosting developer efficiency
* Building, deploying, and continuously improving agent-based automation solutions that help engineering teams move faster and with higher quality
* Collaborating with teams across the company to plan and drive software objectives for the team

**What We Need To See**

* B.E./B.Tech or higher degree in Computer Science/Engineering with significant graphics, system software, AI, or automation-related project or thesis work
* 5+ years of experience and passion for developing system software, device drivers, embedded software, graphics applications, or engineering automation systems
* Strong C/C++ programming skills and a deep understanding of computer graphics, computer architecture, operating system fundamentals, algorithms, and machine learning
* Familiarity with building, integrating, or deploying AI agents, AI-assisted developer tools, or automation systems for engineering workflows
* Passion for identifying repetitive or high-value engineering workflows and automating them through intelligent software solutions
* Diligence and proven ability to multitask in a dynamic environment with shifting priorities and changing requirements

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Having knowledge of 3D graphics concepts and graphics programming using DirectX or OpenGL is highly advantageous
* Working experience inside operating system kernels and device drivers is also a plus
* Familiarity with machine learning algorithms and the mathematical concepts that underpin them is useful
* Practical experience with LLMs, AI agents, retrieval systems, tool-based automation, automation frameworks, or AI-supported software engineering tools is greatly beneficial
* Established skill in spotting and automating routine or complicated engineering workflows with AI-powered systems is a significant benefit

NVIDIA is widely known as a top employer in the technology industry. We have some of the most forward-thinking and driven individuals on our team. If you're creative, dedicated, and passionate about building both world-class graphics software and engineering automation guided by intelligent systems, we want to hear from you.
  
  
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We are seeking a highly skilled and innovative CPU Software Architect to join our engineering team at Qualcomm. In this role, you will be responsible for developing and optimizing software that enhances CPU performance, power efficiency, and scalability across various product segments. You will leverage your expertise in computer architecture, software development, and performance analysis to drive improvements in software stacks, including Linux internals, device drivers, and application workloads. Your work will directly impact the performance benchmarks and silicon verification processes, ensuring that Qualcomm’s next-generation products meet stringent performance and energy efficiency standards.

Your role will involve evaluating optimization opportunities and implementing solutions that meet stringent performance requirements. Additionally, you will contribute to the continuous improvement of software stacks, ensuring that Qualcomm’s products remain at the forefront of technological innovation and efficiency.

Additionally, employees benefit from a collaborative corporate culture that values diversity, inclusion, and innovation, fostering an engaging and rewarding work experience.

Your focus will be on designing embedded Linux-based firmware that interfaces with Broadcom broadband SoC platforms, implementing dynamic RF control loops such as AGC, tilt, and gain, and managing modern cable plant telemetry using protocols like gNMI, Protobuf, and MQTT. This position offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the development of innovative solutions that enhance the reliability and performance of broadband networks worldwide.
  
  
**Qualifications**
The ideal candidate will possess a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, with a minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in embedded software or firmware development. Strong proficiency in modern C and C++ programming is essential. Candidates should have a solid understanding of RF fundamentals, especially in the context of cable and RF transmission paths, including dynamic signal management and AGC control loops. Experience working with Broadcom broadband SoCs and SDKs at the register and hardware abstraction levels is required. Additionally, applicants should have deep expertise in Embedded Linux driver development, Linux networking internals, and peripheral bus protocols such as I2C, SPI, and UART. Practical experience implementing telemetry and serialization protocols like gNMI, Protobuf, JSON, and MQTT is also necessary. Effective communication skills in English and the ability to collaborate with US-based teams are critical for success in this role.

Develop low-level firmware using Broadcom SDKs tailored for broadband and cable access SoCs to initialize, configure, and monitor RF hardware components.

Control on-board peripherals, RF attenuators, equalizers, power amplifiers, and environmental sensors through I2C, SPI, and GPIO interfaces.
  
  
Design, develop, and maintain custom Linux kernel drivers, character devices, and user-space daemons that interact directly with hardware registers and memory-mapped I/O.

Collaborate actively with US-based firmware, RF hardware, and systems engineering teams through design reviews, code reviews, and architectural planning sessions.
  
  
Perform hardware bring-up on custom Broadcom SoC evaluation boards and production hardware, utilizing oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and RF spectrum analyzers for validation and troubleshooting.
  
  
Contribute to continuous improvement of firmware processes, ensuring robustness, efficiency, and scalability of the solutions developed.

* Ensuring that code is error free or has no bugs and test failure
* Preparing reports on programming project specifications, activities and status
* Ensure all the codes are raised as per the norm defined for project / program / account with clear description and replication patterns
